subject: Next steps — coordinate demo window and bring security/procurement into loop
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reed <tom.reed@harborretail.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@seaplane.io>
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-08-03T14:05:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed next-demo windows

Hi Tom / Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared playbook: 

- Summary: Harbor is focused on low-latency inference for checkout suggestions across 30 US stores and a pilot for recommendations at checkout. Key constraints: PII redaction needs, on-prem VPC option for logs retention, and procurement timeline (~Q4 commit).
- Next concrete step: technical deep-dive + short integration planning session (60 minutes). We should include a security engineer and the procurement lead so we can confirm data handling and contract timeline.

I’ve proposed two 60-minute windows below — please pick whichever works best and I’ll lock it in: 
- Tue Aug 12 — 16:00–17:00 PT (UTC-7)
- Thu Aug 14 — 09:00–10:00 PT (UTC-7)

Attachments: high-level-demo-agenda.pdf (outline + ask list), procurement-checklist.xlsx (what procurement usually requests).

Please also confirm the best security contact (name + email) so we can invite them. Rafael from our side will be the technical lead on the call; I’ll loop in Marissa (CS) for pilot planning after the technical deep-dive.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

---
Note: attachments are stubs: [high-level-demo-agenda.pdf] (6 pages), [procurement-checklist.xlsx] (sheet with checklist).

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@harborretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@seaplane.io>
Date: 2025-08-03T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed next-demo windows

Olga — thanks for the clear summary. Both windows look doable but our security lead is only available on the 14th. Can we tentatively hold Thu Aug 14 09:00–10:00 PT?

Looping in our security alias (devops@harborretail.com) — they’ll confirm the individual who should join. Also copying Sarah since she’s coordinating legal/procurement timelines.

Two quick asks before the session: 
1) Can you include a short slide on how Redwood handles KV cache and prefix caching (we need to understand retention options)?
2) Any checklist items we should pre-share for our procurement team so they can triage ahead of time?

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reed
Head of Digital Experience | Harbor Retail
tom.reed@harborretail.com

Date: 2025-08-04T09:10:00Z
Subject: Confirming Thu Aug 14 + security & procurement pointers

Tom / Harbor DevOps —

Thanks for confirming the 14th — I’ve tentatively booked Thu Aug 14 09:00–10:00 PT on our side and sent a calendar hold (invite pending when we have final attendee list).

For the security lead: could you please confirm who will join (name + email) so we can add them to the invite and share the short security appendix (2 slides) that Rafael will present. If it’s helpful, Rafael will cover: KV/prefix caching behavior, options for logs retention and isolation (VPC/private control plane), and recommended quantization/throughput tradeoffs for your expected QPS.

Procurement pre-reads I’m attaching here (see attachment stubs): procurement-checklist.xlsx — this includes typical contract checklist items (SLA targets, data residency, audit logs, export controls). If you want, Marissa can run a 20-minute procurement-only sync the week after the technical deep-dive to accelerate redlines.

Action items for us (Redwood):
- Rafael: prepare 2-slide security appendix + demo snippets for KV cache (by Aug 12)
- Marissa: draft pilot success criteria + timeline (will share after technical call)
- Olga: prepare short engineering access checklist for sandbox access (shared in invite)

If anyone needs different timing, flag it here and we’ll pivot. Otherwise I’ll send the final calendar invite once security confirms the attendee.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
